_about.purpose: Quality gate for tests/test_matching_benchmark.py. The benchmark asserts the current ranker is no worse than every number in 'metrics'. This is a regression gate, not a target.
_about.regenerate: Only when a change is intended to move these numbers: run tests/test_matching_benchmark.py::test_report_measured_metrics with -s, read the printed 'current vs baseline' table, and update the values deliberately.
_about.ceilings: The dataset contains 7 'relevant' rows, so precision@10 cannot exceed 0.70. Rows labelled adjacent, over_experience_bar, preference_mismatch and edge are excluded from precision and recall, which is why precision@20 is not simply 7/20.
_about.previous_metrics_caveat: 'previous_metrics' were measured on the ranker before the required/preferred/incidental skill classification, the role-family rule and the description-derived experience bar were added, against dataset version 3. Applying the prose experience bar then revealed that seven rows had been mislabelled 'adjacent' when the project's own 2-year tolerance should exclude them, so versions 4 and 5 relabelled those rows. The aggregate precision figures therefore have different denominators across the two runs and should not be subtracted from each other. The false-positive rate and the per-row facts below are directly comparable.
